en.help.scan.workflow: Keep a scan source selected while cleaning, aligning, extracting profiles and reconstructing surfaces. Follow the stages and launch each tool with its remembered settings.
en.workflow.text_01: Save a working copy, then isolate the part and remove unwanted scan data. Keep the original scan for comparison.
en.workflow.text_11: Fit a reliable region to a plane. Align it to the coordinate system, then rotate and move within the aligned plane.
en.workflow.text_17: Separate mounting details from the visible skin. Inspect sections before choosing the surfaces to rebuild.
en.workflow.text_23: Use thin scan slices (0.5-1 mm) and orient sections across the shape. Add closely spaced sections at tight bends. Trace or fit the wall profiles, then draw 3D guides through corresponding section endpoints.
en.workflow.text_31: Loft adjacent sections with the 3D guide curves. Add a local guide if the surface twists. Use boundary patches at tapered tips, then stitch and thicken. Rebuild mounting features separately.
en.workflow.text_38: Inspect the result and save the editable design. Compare Scans currently compares two meshes; CAD-to-scan deviation is not available yet.
